bug_semantics: Assigned CVE-2026-8449 was rejected/withdrawn at CVE.org and NVD as a duplicate identifier. The underlying ksmbd issue (canonical CVE-2026-43490) is a remote heap OOB read/corruption in smb_inherit_dacl(): a crafted inheritable ACE with inflated sid.num_subauth is used by compare_sids() and smb_set_ace() without checking that the SID bytes fit in the ACE.
flaw_origin: CVE-2026-8449 (VulnCheck CNA) was published 2026-05-12 and rejected 2026-05-13 with reason "This CVE ID has been rejected or withdrawn." NVD vulnStatus is Rejected. GitHub GHSA-898m-7rf9-qg74 still has withdrawn_at null, which is not authoritative. The same mechanism is tracked as analyzed CVE-2026-43490 (Linux CNA) with Fixes: e2f34481b24d and patch 996454bc0da84d5a1dedb1a7861823087e01a7ae.
ai_marker: absent; not judged — assigned CVE-2026-8449 is rejected, so BIC AI attribution is out of scope for this advisory
evidence: CVE.org record CVE-2026-8449: cveMetadata.state=REJECTED, dateRejected=2026-05-13T15:14:52.974Z, assigner VulnCheck, rejectedReasons "This CVE ID has been rejected or withdrawn." NVD CVE-2026-8449 API: vulnStatus=Rejected, lastModified 2026-05-13T16:17:05.807, descriptions rejected reason only, empty references. GitHub advisory GHSA-898m-7rf9-qg74 still lists CVE-2026-8449 with withdrawn_at null (protocol: GitHub withdrawn_at is not authoritative). Canonical duplicate CVE-2026-43490 is Analyzed at NVD (Linux CNA 416baaa9-dc9f-4396-8d5f-8c081fb06d67); description is the ksmbd inherited ACE SID length bug; git ranges from e2f34481b24db2fd634b5edb0a5bd0e4d38cc6e9 until 996454bc0da84d5a1dedb1a7861823087e01a7ae (and stable backports). Clone linux-inspect contains both commits: e2f34481 added fs/cifsd/smbacl.c smb_inherit_dacl/smb_set_ace using sid->num_subauth; 996454bc (Shota Zaizen / Steve French) validates inherited ACE SID length. Bundle withdrawn_at is null because GHSA was not withdrawn.
reasoning: The assigned case is CVE-2026-8449 / GHSA-898m-7rf9-qg74. CVE.org and NVD both mark CVE-2026-8449 REJECTED/withdrawn (duplicate of the later kernel CVE-2026-43490). Protocol requires withdrawn/rejected advisories to be FALSE_POSITIVE rather than NOT_AI, and GitHub withdrawn_at is not controlling. Introducer/fix SHAs are omitted on this record because the assigned advisory ID is not a live CVE; the real bug lives under CVE-2026-43490 and is outside this case_id.
